title: SORTENTSTABLE DXF OBJECTS writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated full-file ASCII/Binary AC1027 SORTENTSTABLE graph and codec transaction control only; no source-producer or support claim.

implementation.path: Public DXF OBJECTS callback in a complete dxfRW::write operation
implementation.profile: NOD parent, model-space BLOCK_RECORD owner, four emitted model-space LINE targets paired with sort keys, and two EED values

assertions: Each injected allocation failure returns a failed write and preserves pre-existing destination bytes.
The caller DRW_SortEntsTable, including handles, owner, sort pairs, and EED values, is unchanged after failure.
The generated graph writes four model-space LINE targets; after serialization each remapped group-331 target resolves to its emitted LINE, whose owner is the model-space BLOCK_RECORD.
Retry with the same writer and table reproduces byte-identical output to the clean write.
Fresh typed libdxfrw readback reproduces selected table fields and EED values for ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.observed_allocation_counts: ASCII 18; Binary 17 in both normal and ASan executables

limitations: Generated controls establish graph closure for this authored four-LINE profile, rollback, retry, byte equality, and same-library readback only.
No physical source graph, producer coverage, non-model/paper-space owner qualification, or native consumer behavior is established; strict support gates are unchanged.
DXF files are generated from scratch in a temporary directory and removed; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
